recipients.subject: Considering Clio or Filevine?
recipients.body:
Hi Alex,

You handle cases from the first client call through appeal. Any software change needs to preserve that history, not give your team more admin work.

If PARRIS is considering a move from ProLaw, we can help plan and carry out a migration to Clio or Filevine, mapping records, documents and workflows so they're better connected for AI and automation.

I'm Pranav, founder of Possible Minds, previously at McKinsey and Expedia. We built Precise Imaging's email-handling system, which processes over 600 emails daily, routes requests and sends automated status responses.

Here's how we approach migration:
https://getpossibleminds.com/t/7FUyplVojA

Would a brief outline of what a move could involve be useful? I'd appreciate your thoughts.

Best,
Pranav
Founder, Possible Minds
